---
title: "JacksonJ"
output: html_document
---

required_packages <- c("haven", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "scales", "survey")

missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    install.packages(missing_packages)
}

library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(survey)

options(
    survey.lonely.psu = "adjust",
    survey.adjust.domain.lonely = TRUE
)

cat("Choose faps_individual_puf.sas7bdat, then faps_household_puf.sas7bdat.\n")

paths <- c(file.choose(), file.choose())

inputs <- lapply(paths, haven::read_sas)

inputs <- lapply(inputs, function(x) {
    names(x) <- tolower(names(x))
    x
})

individual_index <- which(vapply(inputs, function(x) {
    all(c(
        "hhnum", "age_r", "healthstatus",
        "bmicat", "hhwgt", "tsstrata", "tspsu"
    ) %in% names(x))
}, logical(1)))

household_index <- which(vapply(inputs, function(x) {
    all(c("hhnum", "adltfscat") %in% names(x))
}, logical(1)))

if (
    length(individual_index) != 1 ||
    length(household_index) != 1 ||
    individual_index == household_index
) {
    stop("Choose exactly the individual and household FoodAPS SAS files.")
}

individual <- inputs[[individual_index]]
household <- inputs[[household_index]]

output_dir <- dirname(paths[individual_index])

individual_data <- individual %>%
    transmute(
        hhnum = as.numeric(hhnum),
        age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(age_r)),
        health = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(healthstatus)),
        bmi = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bmicat)),
        weight = as.numeric(hhwgt),
        stratum = as.numeric(tsstrata),
        psu = as.numeric(tspsu)
    )

household_data <- household %>%
    transmute(
        hhnum = as.numeric(hhnum),
        fs = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(adltfscat))
    )

if (anyDuplicated(household_data$hhnum)) {
    stop("Household ID is not unique in the selected household dataset.")
}

fs_labels <- c(
    "1 High",
    "2 Marginal",
    "3 Low",
    "4 Very low"
)

health_labels <- c(
    "1 Excellent",
    "2 Very good",
    "3 Good",
    "4 Fair",
    "5 Poor"
)

age_labels <- c(
    "18-35",
    "36-59",
    "60-70",
    "71+"
)

analysis_data <- individual_data %>%
    inner_join(
        household_data,
        by = "hhnum"
    ) %>%
    filter(
        !is.na(age),
        age >= 18,
        health %in% 1:5,
        fs %in% 1:4,
        !is.na(weight),
        weight > 0,
        !is.na(stratum),
        !is.na(psu)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        poor_health = as.numeric(health %in% c(4, 5)),
        bmi_cat = factor(
            bmi,
            levels = 1:3,
            labels = c(
                "Not overweight",
                "Overweight",
                "Obese"
            )
        ),
        fs_cat = factor(
            fs,
            levels = 1:4,
            labels = fs_labels
        ),
        health_cat = factor(
            health,
            levels = 1:5,
            labels = health_labels
        ),
        age_group = case_when(
            age %in% c(18, 19, 27.5) ~ "18-35",
            age == 47.5 ~ "36-59",
            age %in% c(62.5, 68) ~ "60-70",
            age == 85 ~ "71+",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        age_group = factor(
            age_group,
            levels = age_labels
        )
    )

if (nrow(analysis_data) == 0) {
    stop("No valid adult records were found.")
}

survey_design <- survey::svydesign(
    ids = ~psu,
    strata = ~stratum,
    weights = ~weight,
    nest = TRUE,
    data = analysis_data
)

okabe_health <- c(
    "1 Excellent" = rgb(213, 94, 0, maxColorValue = 255),
    "2 Very good" = rgb(240, 228, 66, maxColorValue = 255),
    "3 Good" = rgb(0, 158, 115, maxColorValue = 255),
    "4 Fair" = rgb(86, 180, 233, maxColorValue = 255),
    "5 Poor" = rgb(204, 121, 167, maxColorValue = 255)
)

okabe_fs <- c(
    "1 High" = rgb(0, 114, 178, maxColorValue = 255),
    "2 Marginal" = rgb(0, 158, 115, maxColorValue = 255),
    "3 Low" = rgb(230, 159, 0, maxColorValue = 255),
    "4 Very low" = rgb(204, 121, 167, maxColorValue = 255)
)

blue <- rgb(0, 114, 178, maxColorValue = 255)

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
            face = "bold",
            size = 18
        ),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(
            size = 11,
            color = "gray35"
        ),
        plot.caption = element_text(
            size = 9,
            color = "gray45",
            hjust = 0
        ),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
            color = "gray88",
            linewidth = 0.35
        ),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
        plot.margin = margin(18, 20, 14, 18)
    )

percent_summary <- function(design, variable) {
    grouped <- survey::svyby(
        ~poor_health,
        stats::as.formula(paste0("~", variable)),
        design = design,
        FUN = survey::svymean,
        na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    crit <- qt(
        0.975,
        df = survey::degf(design)
    )
    
    estimate <- as.numeric(coef(grouped))
    standard_error <- as.numeric(survey::SE(grouped))
    
    data.frame(
        category = as.character(grouped[[variable]]),
        estimate = estimate,
        se = standard_error,
        lower = pmax(
            0,
            estimate - crit * standard_error
        ),
        upper = pmin(
            1,
            estimate + crit * standard_error
        )
    )
}

p_label <- function(p) {
    paste0(
        "p = ",
        format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
    )
}

save_plot <- function(plot, stem) {
    print(plot)
    
    ggsave(
        file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")),
        plot = plot,
        width = 12,
        height = 7.2,
        dpi = 300,
        bg = "white"
    )
    
    ggsave(
        file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")),
        plot = plot,
        width = 12,
        height = 7.2,
        bg = "white"
    )
}

bmi_design <- subset(
    survey_design,
    !is.na(bmi_cat)
)

bmi_results <- percent_summary(
    bmi_design,
    "bmi_cat"
) %>%
    mutate(
        category = factor(
            category,
            levels = c(
                "Not overweight",
                "Overweight",
                "Obese"
            )
        )
    )

bmi_fit <- survey::svyglm(
    poor_health ~ bmi_cat,
    design = bmi_design
)

bmi_anova <- survey::regTermTest(
    bmi_fit,
    ~bmi_cat
)

p14 <- ggplot(
    bmi_results,
    aes(
        x = category,
        y = estimate,
        group = 1
    )
) +
    geom_line(
        color = blue,
        linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(
            ymin = lower,
            ymax = upper
        ),
        width = 0.12,
        color = blue,
        linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
        size = 3.5,
        color = blue
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.10),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
        ylim = c(
            0,
            max(
                0.45,
                ceiling(max(bmi_results$upper) * 10) / 10
            )
        )
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "BMI Category and Fair or Poor Health",
        subtitle = paste(
            "Survey-weighted prevalence with 95% CI | One-way ANOVA:",
            p_label(bmi_anova$p)
        ),
        x = "Adult BMI category",
        y = "Adults reporting fair or poor health",
        caption = "USDA FoodAPS | Design-based SEs | Fair/poor = HEALTHSTATUS 4 or 5"
    ) +
    plot_theme

save_plot(
    p14,
    "slide14_BMI_one_way_ANOVA"
)

fs_results <- percent_summary(
    survey_design,
    "fs_cat"
) %>%
    mutate(
        category = factor(
            category,
            levels = fs_labels
        )
    )

fs_fit <- survey::svyglm(
    poor_health ~ fs_cat,
    design = survey_design
)

fs_anova <- survey::regTermTest(
    fs_fit,
    ~fs_cat
)

p15 <- ggplot(
    fs_results,
    aes(
        x = category,
        y = estimate,
        group = 1
    )
) +
    geom_line(
        color = blue,
        linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(
            ymin = lower,
            ymax = upper
        ),
        width = 0.12,
        color = blue,
        linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
        size = 3.5,
        color = blue
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.10),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
        ylim = c(
            0,
            max(
                0.55,
                ceiling(max(fs_results$upper) * 10) / 10
            )
        )
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Food Security and Fair or Poor Health",
        subtitle = paste(
            "Survey-weighted prevalence with 95% CI | One-way ANOVA:",
            p_label(fs_anova$p)
        ),
        x = "Adult household food-security category",
        y = "Adults reporting fair or poor health",
        caption = "USDA FoodAPS | Design-based SEs | Categories 1=high to 4=very low food security"
    ) +
    plot_theme

save_plot(
    p15,
    "slide15_food_security_one_way_ANOVA"
)

health_stack <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(
        fs_cat,
        health_cat
    ) %>%
    summarise(
        weighted_count = sum(weight),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(fs_cat) %>%
    mutate(
        percentage = weighted_count / sum(weighted_count)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

health_chisq <- survey::svychisq(
    ~fs_cat + health_cat,
    design = survey_design,
    statistic = "F"
)

p16 <- ggplot(
    health_stack,
    aes(
        x = fs_cat,
        y = weighted_count,
        fill = health_cat
    )
) +
    geom_col(
        position = "fill",
        width = 0.78
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = okabe_health,
        drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
        ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Health Status Distribution by Food Security",
        subtitle = paste(
            "Survey-weighted composition | Rao-Scott association test:",
            p_label(health_chisq$p.value)
        ),
        x = "Adult household food-security category",
        y = "Percentage of adults",
        fill = "Self-reported health",
        caption = "USDA FoodAPS | Each column totals 100% | Okabe-Ito palette"
    ) +
    guides(
        fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
    ) +
    plot_theme

save_plot(
    p16,
    "slide16_health_distribution_100percent"
)

age_design <- subset(
    survey_design,
    !is.na(age_group)
)

interaction_fit <- survey::svyglm(
    poor_health ~ age_group * fs_cat,
    design = age_design,
    family = quasibinomial()
)

interaction_test <- survey::regTermTest(
    interaction_fit,
    ~age_group:fs_cat
)

prediction_grid <- expand.grid(
    age_group = factor(
        age_labels,
        levels = age_labels
    ),
    fs_cat = factor(
        fs_labels,
        levels = fs_labels
    )
)

X <- model.matrix(
    ~age_group * fs_cat,
    data = prediction_grid
)

beta <- coef(interaction_fit)
variance <- vcov(interaction_fit)

eta <- as.vector(X %*% beta)

se_eta <- sqrt(
    pmax(
        0,
        rowSums((X %*% variance) * X)
    )
)

crit <- qt(
    0.975,
    df = survey::degf(age_design)
)

prediction_grid <- prediction_grid %>%
    mutate(
        estimate = plogis(eta),
        lower = plogis(eta - crit * se_eta),
        upper = plogis(eta + crit * se_eta)
    )

p17 <- ggplot(
    prediction_grid,
    aes(
        x = age_group,
        y = estimate,
        color = fs_cat,
        group = fs_cat
    )
) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.05) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(
            ymin = lower,
            ymax = upper
        ),
        width = 0.12,
        linewidth = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
        values = okabe_fs,
        drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.10),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
        ylim = c(
            0,
            max(
                0.65,
                ceiling(max(prediction_grid$upper) * 10) / 10
            )
        )
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Fair or Poor Health by Age and Food Security",
        subtitle = paste(
            "Survey-weighted logistic regression | Age x food-security interaction:",
            p_label(interaction_test$p)
        ),
        x = "Age band in FoodAPS public-use data",
        y = "Model-predicted probability of fair or poor health",
        color = "Food security",
        caption = "USDA FoodAPS | 95% design-based CI | Imputed age=40 excluded from age models"
    ) +
    guides(
        color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
    ) +
    plot_theme

save_plot(
    p17,
    "slide17_age_food_security_logistic_interaction"
)

write.csv(
    bmi_results,
    file.path(output_dir, "slide14_BMI_results.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
    fs_results,
    file.path(output_dir, "slide15_food_security_results.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
    health_stack,
    file.path(output_dir, "slide16_health_distribution_results.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
    prediction_grid,
    file.path(output_dir, "slide17_logistic_predictions.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
)

capture.output(
    {
        cat("SLIDE 14: SURVEY-WEIGHTED ONE-WAY ANOVA (BMI)\n")
        print(bmi_anova)
        
        cat("\nSLIDE 15: SURVEY-WEIGHTED ONE-WAY ANOVA (FOOD SECURITY)\n")
        print(fs_anova)
        
        cat("\nSLIDE 16: RAO-SCOTT HEALTH STATUS x FOOD SECURITY\n")
        print(health_chisq)
        
        cat("\nSLIDE 17: SURVEY-WEIGHTED LOGISTIC AGE x FOOD SECURITY INTERACTION\n")
        print(interaction_test)
        
        cat("\nMODEL SUMMARY\n")
        print(summary(interaction_fit))
        
        cat(
            "\nADULT SAMPLE: ",
            nrow(analysis_data),
            " records in ",
            n_distinct(analysis_data$hhnum),
            " households\n",
            sep = ""
        )
        
        cat(
            "LOGISTIC MODEL SAMPLE: ",
            nrow(model.frame(interaction_fit)),
            "\n",
            sep = ""
        )
    },
    file = file.path(
        output_dir,
        "FoodAPS_statistical_tests.txt"
    )
)

cat("Created four PNG charts, four PDFs, four CSV tables, and statistical tests in:\n")

cat(output_dir, "\n")

cat(
    "Adult records:",
    nrow(analysis_data),
    "| Households:",
    n_distinct(analysis_data$hhnum),
    "\n"
)
